tasks.task_name: Report provider Connected only when API key resolves
tasks.goal: GET /api/v1/providers reports Connected only when the provider's API key (inline or _ref) resolves to a non-empty credential, otherwise not-connected.

inputs.name: providers_handler
inputs.constraints: HandleProviders rest.go:3387, status hard-coded Connected at :3451

inputs.name: key_resolution
inputs.constraints: resolve api_key_ref via credential store, and inline api_key

outputs.name: status_logic
outputs.constraints: Connected iff key resolves non-empty (+ optional cached test); Disconnected otherwise

acceptance: Given a provider whose api_key_ref resolves empty (or no key), the handler returns a not-connected status.
Given a provider whose api_key_ref resolves to a non-empty credential, the handler returns Connected.
Given a provider configured with an inline (non-_ref) API key, the handler returns Connected.
A go test asserts the four-case status table: _ref non-empty -> Connected, _ref empty -> Disconnected, inline key -> Connected, no key -> Disconnected.
gofmt, golangci-lint, go test -race green.
